KillLevel.description: Kill switch / circuit breaker level. Each level includes the ones below it.
KillLevel.title: KillLevel

ModifyOrderIn.description: Changes to a pending order; omitted fields stay as they are. Risk-checked when it adds risk.
ModifyOrderIn.title: ModifyOrderIn

ModifyPositionIn.description:
New SL/TP for an open position; omitted fields stay as they are. Removing or widening a stop is
risk-checked; tightening always goes through.
ModifyPositionIn.title: ModifyPositionIn

StrategyCreateIn.description: Same fields as a ``strategies:`` entry in the config.
StrategyCreateIn.title: StrategyCreateIn

info.description: Control API of the trading platform. Money, prices and volumes (lots) are decimal strings; times are ISO-8601 UTC. Every mutating call is audited. Manual orders go through the same risk checks as strategy orders.
info.title: Trader Control API

post.description:
Cancel every pending order and close every position. Does not latch the kill switch (strategies
may enter again); `POST /risk/kill` with FLATTEN_ALL does both.

get.description: Execution quality (slippage, latency, fill and requote rates) grouped by ``by``.

parameters.description: comma-separated: broker, symbol, strategy, order_type, hour, account
parameters.name: by

schema.description: comma-separated: broker, symbol, strategy, order_type, hour, account
schema.title: By
Response Execution Stats Analytics Execution Get

get.description: Trade metrics (net, win rate, profit factor, expectancy, drawdown, ...) grouped by ``by``.

post.description:
Manual order (``strategy_id="manual"``) through the RiskEngine and the OMS. A risk rejection is
returned as an order with status ``REJECTED`` and its ``rejection_reason``.

patch.description:
Change a pending order. A change that adds risk (more volume, a new entry price, a stop removed
or moved away) goes through the risk checks; a refusal is 409 with `risk:<rule>` in the detail.

get.description: Realized P&L of a trading day (default today) by strategy and symbol, plus current equity.

post.description: Close every position (and cancel pending orders) of an account, a symbol or a strategy.

patch.description:
New SL/TP. Removing or widening a stop is risk-checked (409 when refused, e.g. under a kill
switch); tightening always goes through.

post.description: Close a position (or ``volume`` lots of it). Risk-reducing: allowed under any kill-switch level.
Manual kill switch. ``account: "*"`` sets it on every account.
Clear the manual switch and latched breakers; conditions that still hold trigger again.

Load (and by default start) a strategy instance. It lasts until the process stops: add it to the
config file to keep it.

put.description: Replace the params: the old instance stops cleanly and a new one starts with its state.

post.description: Start a loaded or stopped strategy, or resume a paused one (409 under a kill switch).
